title: OFM gaia.json
description: Per-world AI-agent + layer config consumed by gaia_agent's MCP server and the Gaia API.

version.description: Schema version of this gaia.json. Only 1.0 exists today.

system.description: System-prompt fragments handed to the in-world AI observer. Concatenated by gaia_agent.

image.description: Prompt fragments used when the agent describes visuals.

inspect_world.description: One-sentence description of the world for the world picker.

sources.description: Layer/table names the agent should read directly. Order matters for stacking.

indirect.description: Layers the agent should only consult via secondary queries (e.g. politics, factions).

terrain.description: Terrain classes used by the renderer + agent (e.g. 'desert', 'forest', 'silt').

agents.description: Agent table names that hold tracked NPCs/actors.

inspection_presets.description: Pre-canned observer personas exposed in the inspect UI (e.g. 'Wizard', 'Nord warrior').
